text:
maria.g: quick follow-up from the quant rfc — sketching an observability schema for quant artifacts that we can surface in the console. want a quick sanity check before i open a PR.

samir: love it, high-level first: is this tied to profiles or to model+profile+route?

maria.g: model+profile+route. main aim: make it easy to debug per-customer regressions and to correlate with prompt anchors.

aj: tiny ask: include a compact example payload and a sample query for the console so SREs can wire alerts.

maria.g: good call. here's the payload prototype i used in the demo:

```
artifact_event: {
  model: "redwood-v2-medium",
  profile_id: "fp8-aggressive-2026-03",
  route: "/chat/generate",
  fidelity_budget: 0.12,            # fraction of tokens allowed to deviate
  degrade_score: 0.87,              # runtime metric (0..1) indicating quality drop
  quality_anchor: "qa_set_v1",
  anchor_examples: ["weather_report_short", "task_extraction_long_prompt"],
  token_index: 23,
  residual_norm: 0.042,
  kv_mismatch: false,
  sample_output_snippet: "...the result seems less specific about dates..."
}
```

li: minor nit: use snake_case for field names to match other telemetry. also, consider a "bucket" field: {low, medium, high} for quick aggregation.

maria.g: updated mental model: snake_case + bucket. also want the console to show a small diff against the anchor example when we surface an artifact.

ops-bot: /observe quant-artifacts --since 24h --profile fp8-aggressive --group-by route,model

jenna: suggestion for metrics: quant.artifact.count, quant.degrade.p50/p95, quant.anchor.regressions, quant.residual.norm.avg

samir: do we want to emit a separate "explainability" payload when degrade_score > 0.8 that includes token-level saliency-ish info? could be heavy.

maria.g: yes but gated — only for canary/customers. add field explainability_uri that points to retained artifact if collected. default false.

aj: ops considerations: retention + privacy. do not store PII in sample_output_snippet. we should have a redaction step + TTL policy.

maria.g: agreed. add redaction flag and ttl_seconds. i added this example for console wiring and runbook snippets:

```
# console query example for oncall
/observe quant-artifacts --since 1h --degrade-score>0.7 --filter route:"/chat/generate"

# alert rule sketch
WHEN quant.degrade.p95 > 0.75 for 10m
THEN page oncall -> include top anchor_examples and sample diffs
```

li: this looks actionable. one more request: add an event "artifact_resolution" with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback, profile_tweak, false_positive, noop} so we can close the loop.

maria.g: yes adding that. will open PR with schema + console mockups + small backend logger shim that emits event to telemetry pipeline.

jenna: +1 on TTL/redaction, also please make the explainability_uri require an admin flag to retrieve.

samir: can we include a tiny benchmark: "cost of collecting explainability payloads is ~0.5ms per request + 20kb storage" so product can weigh opt-in?

maria.g: will add numbers. ok i'll draft PR and tag folks. thanks for quick takes :pray:

ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, aj, li, jenna in #eng-ml
